suggestions.assertion: The guide layer reflects the ruling (decisions.md or equivalent showing OQ-002 as ruled)
suggestions.reason: Given assertion 9 already independently requires the guide to be provably regenerable/byte-identical to a fresh render, assertion 8 is largely subsumed by it in this eval design — any run that passes 9 will trivially pass 8, and any run that fails to update the guide fails both for essentially the same underlying reason. Consider merging them or making 8 test something 9 doesn't (e.g. that a human skimming decisions.md alone, without running the renderer, can find the ruling).

eval_feedback.overall: The 3 new assertions (guide regenerability, frozen contracts, scoped re-verification) are strong and discriminating — they caught a real, material gap (stale guide/) that the 8 original assertions, which only look at the spec/ledger layer, would have completely missed. The pre-existing mechanical_checks.json in this run directory independently corroborates the guide-staleness finding ('guide-refreshed': false), which is reassuring cross-validation. No changes needed beyond the minor overlap note above.
